newsitem.title: MOROCCO: U.S. envoy, Arafat, end talks on Middle East.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy, Arafat, end talks on Middle East.

text.p: U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat ended talks on Thursday on the latest bout of Israeli-Palestinian violence and the Jewish state's start of a new settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
Neither man made any comment to reporters after the almost two hours of talks.
Officials said Ross later left for the airport to fly to Israel, where he is expected to meet Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Arafat was expected to have talks with Morocco's King Hassan before the start of the Jerusalem Committee meeting, called by the king to discuss ways to counter Israel's latest Jewish housing project.
